brief.zh: 已知：要是有判定停机的机器，就能造出一台 x，它在 ⟨y⟩ 上停机恰好当 y 在 ⟨y⟩ 上不停机；要是有判定 A_TM 的机器，就能造出判定停机的机器。证明没有机器判定 A_TM。
brief.en: Given: if some machine decides halting, a machine x can be built that halts on ⟨y⟩ exactly when y does not halt on ⟨y⟩; and if some machine decides A_TM, one deciding halting can be built. Prove no machine decides A_TM.

hint.zh: 假设有判定 A_TM 的机器。
hint.en: Assume a machine that decides A_TM.

hint.zh: 最后还是让一台机器读它自己的编码。
hint.en: In the end, a machine still reads its own code.

after.zh: 从一个问题到另一个，这一步叫<wiki-ref to="reduction"></wiki-ref>。一阶逻辑的可证性同样<wiki-ref to="undecidable"></wiki-ref>：没有程序能对每个目标都答出推得出还是推不出。
after.en: Passing from one problem to another is a <wiki-ref to="reduction"></wiki-ref>. Provability in first-order logic shows the same <wiki-ref to="undecidable"></wiki-ref>: no program can say, for every goal, whether it follows.
